purpose: Source-certify canonical SWSE talent publication content without changing production talent records.

sourcePolicy.finalAuthority: Rendered primary-source PDF pages for hierarchy, printed page attribution, prerequisites, same-name identity, class-feature boundaries, sidebars, and OCR ambiguity.

identityRule: sourcebook publication + canonical talent tree + talent name

distinction.explanation: Phase 2 counts sourcebook talent publications. Phase 1D aggregate membership counts the merged canonical tree graph. They are related but intentionally not identical.

Galaxy of Intrigue: removed six named actions misclassified as standalone talents under Dedicated Guardian and Pistol Duelist.
Scum and Villainy: corrected Inspiration/Beloved and removed the Disgrace/Draw Fire cross-tree reference from canonical membership.
Unknown Regions: removed four named sub-actions misclassified as standalone talents under Band Together and Champion.

books.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

productionStatus.note: Phase 2 remained certification/audit only. Per-book content datasets and discrepancy manifests are repair authority for the later production pass.

nextPhaseTarget.goal: Apply the certified Phase 2 authority to production talent records.
